title: A conftest.py change selects the test files that use the fixtures and helpers it changes, not every test file
goal: testmap's selection for _tools/conftest.py reads the changed lines (the diff from the base tests.py --changed is given, plus the working tree) and selects the test files that request a changed fixture as a parameter or by usefixtures, or import or call a changed helper, following the calls inside conftest.py (copy_kb reaches KbTemplate), plus test_conftest.py, the tools-map test and the leak scan; a change outside any function or class (imports, constants, SCOPE_GROUPS), to a pytest hook (pytest_configure, pytest_collection_modifyitems, pytest_xdist_make_scheduler) or to an autouse fixture, or a diff it cannot attribute, still selects all; planted cases for each: a changed helper selects its users only, a changed hook and a changed autouse fixture select all, a helper reached through another helper selects the outer one's users

gates.question: How does a conftest.py change pick its tests in the sync gate? fixture-map = testmap attributes the changed lines to fixtures and helpers and selects their users, hooks, autouse fixtures and module-level lines still all; runner-too = fixture-map, and a tests.py or testmap.py change selects their own test files plus a fixed smoke set instead of all; split = conftest.py keeps only hooks and autouse fixtures and its helpers move to an imported module, so the import graph selects their users (55 importing test files change); keep = every conftest.py change selects all

notes: Premise (run before a sprint commits it): python3 _tools/testmap.py explain --paths _tools/conftest.py prints 'shared test setup: every test' and all. Data: of the 382 code merges since 2026-10-01, 8 changed conftest.py (14 tests.py, 3 testmap.py: 25, 6.5%, each selecting every test file); the committed ops rows hold 8 sync gates of scope all (2026-10-03), median 238 s, max 528 s on macOS; on the Windows host an all gate runs the whole suite without git scenarios (estimated 10 to 12 min) and is red there whatever the change while the host's pre-existing failures last. Live run over the repository: conftest.py holds 30 top-level definitions, 3 pytest hooks and 2 autouse fixtures (hook_off_cleared, kb_templates_untouched) that keep selecting all, kb_seed and 24 helpers that test files use by name (55 test files import from conftest; kb_seed 7 files, Repo 23, git_env 22, querylog_env 11, copy_kb 11, timeout_s 7, KbTemplate through kb_seed and copy_kb). tests.py and testmap.py stay in testmap.EVERYTHING unless the operator's answer says runner-too.
